subject: Post-call: Helix Labs discovery + rotating demo cadence (proposal)
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@helixlabs.com>, Elena Morales <elena@helixlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Helix Labs discovery + rotating demo cadence (proposal)

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on Helix’s inference priorities (throughput predictability, multi-region compliance, and lower per-token cost for batch pipelines). Quick recap and proposals so we can lock the next deep dive:

Summary (2-min):
- Core use case: model serving for inference-heavy batch jobs (medical imaging preproc + classification), peak windows in US daytime and EU evening.
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence required; Helix needs a private deployment or dedicated capacity with strict data residency.
- Decision maker / stakeholders: Elena (infra lead), Samir (platform owner), and a separate security reviewer TBD.

Immediate asks / next steps (proposed):
1) Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive (Ben + Runtime eng + you) to walk architecture, perf numbers, and deployment options.
2) Share a mutual action plan draft (attached) so we can align owners and timeline.
3) Agree on a rotating meeting cadence that ensures at least one live overlap for US/EU/APAC each week so the engineers can attend without repeated late nights.

Rotating cadence proposal (short):
- Week A (US-friendly): 10:00–11:00 PT (US West) — 18:00–19:00 BST / 19:00–20:00 CEST
- Week B (EU-friendly): 16:00–17:00 CEST — 07:00–08:00 PT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 09:00–10:00 JST/AEST — 16:00–17:00 PT

This would repeat on a three-week rotation. The goal is to avoid a single timezone always carrying late-night meetings while still giving Helix predictable windows where core cross-functional folks can join. We can compress to a two-week rotation if preferred.

Proposed concrete slots for the next three sessions (pick one option per week):
- Week A (US): Tue 26 May, 10:00–11:00 PT / Tue 26 May, 18:00–19:00 BST
- Week B (EU): Thu 04 Jun, 16:00–17:00 CEST / Thu 04 Jun, 07:00–08:00 PT
- Week C (APAC): Mon 08 Jun, 09:00–10:00 JST / Mon 08 Jun, 16:00–17:00 PT

If you prefer we can also provide a Doodle link — happy to do that if these three options feel too prescriptive.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MVP timeline + owners) and a sample calendar invite (.ics) for the US slot.

Please reply with which slot(s) work and any timezone constraints (Elena, you mentioned the security review window is Fridays after 14:00 CEST — we can avoid scheduling on that block).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122

--

-----Original Message-----
From: Samir Patel <samir@helixlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@helixlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 23:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: Helix Labs discovery + rotating demo cadence (proposal)

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary and suggested windows. Quick constraints from our side:
- Elena is based in Madrid (CEST), and she’s out Mon–Tue afternoons next week (meetings).
- Our infra team in Bangalore prefers not to be scheduled before 10:30 IST most days.
- Security can only do a 60-minute review slot on Fridays after 14:00 CEST, as Jordan noted.

The three-week rotation concept sounds sensible. A couple of asks / clarifications:
1) Can we narrow the US-friendly slot to 09:00–10:00 PT instead of 10:00–11:00 PT? That gives our West Coast engineers a slightly earlier window and moves EU overlap to 17:00–18:00 BST which is better for Elena.
2) For APAC weeks, could we pick 08:30–09:30 IST as the anchor (that maps to ~20:00–21:00 CEST and 11:00–12:00 PT) — it helps our Bangalore folks join without a midnight call.

If you can send two firm candidate slots for each of the three weeks (one slightly earlier, one at your original times), I’ll confirm availability internally and loop in the security contact (so we can attach their review session to the mutual action plan).

Thanks —
Samir
Platform Owner | Helix Labs
samir@helixlabs.com

--

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@helixlabs.com>, Elena Morales <elena@helixlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Helix Labs discovery + rotating demo cadence (proposal)

Samir / Elena —

Thanks for the notes. Jordan — I like Samir’s tweaks. Quick counter-proposal with two candidate times per week (local times included):

Week A (US-friendly):
- Option 1: Tue 26 May 09:00–10:00 PT (Tue 26 May 17:00–18:00 BST / 18:00–19:00 CEST)
- Option 2: Tue 26 May 10:00–11:00 PT (Tue 26 May 18:00–19:00 BST / 19:00–20:00 CEST)

Week B (EU-friendly):
- Option 1: Thu 04 Jun 15:30–16:30 CEST (Thu 04 Jun 06:30–07:30 PT)
- Option 2: Thu 04 Jun 16:00–17:00 CEST (Thu 04 Jun 07:00–08:00 PT)

Week C (APAC-friendly):
- Option 1: Mon 08 Jun 08:30–09:30 IST (Mon 08 Jun 13:00–14:00 BST / Mon 08 Jun 20:00–21:00 CEST / Mon 08 Jun 11:00–12:00 PT)
- Option 2: Mon 08 Jun 09:00–10:00 JST (Mon 08 Jun 01:00–02:00 PT — probably worse for PT, so we include JST option only if APAC team prefers that slot)

I’ll hold 09:00–10:00 PT on Tue 26 May on my calendar tentatively and attach a sample invite (redwood-deepdive-rooms.ics).

Jordan — once you have confirmation from Samir / Elena we can: (a) finalize mutual_action_plan.xlsx with deadlines, (b) loop in our Security Solutions engineer for the Friday 14:00 CEST slot for evidence review, and (c) run a quick smoke test of the demo pipeline on our Dedicated stack so we have throughput numbers ready.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@helixlabs.com>, Elena Morales <elena@helixlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Helix Labs discovery + rotating demo cadence (proposal)

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Samir.

Elena / Samir: please confirm which option you prefer for each week. If you’re comfortable I’ll:
- Lock Option 1 for Week A (Tue 26 May 09:00–10:00 PT) and send the calendar invites to all participants (including the provisional security slot on Fri 05 Jun 14:00 CEST),
- Send a short pre-read ahead of Week A (agenda + perf highlights), and
- Update the attached mutual_action_plan.xlsx with the security contact and next milestones.

If I don’t hear back by end of day PT Friday I’ll go ahead and lock the Week A Option 1 to keep momentum.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft), redwood-deepdive-rooms.ics (calendar invite stub)
